text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O managed to finish the 
Twinkle Series in style.

We were able to get through the very 
important "first three years" together――

One day, I was basking in the afterglow of 
such a big milestone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It's over this way, this way this 
way!

Sakura Bakushin O had invited me to visit 
a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The sakura mochi here is aaaabsolutely 
delicious! You're almost sure to be 
completely and totally amazed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll go and get you one, just wait one 
minute!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nono! It's a thank-you day for Trainer, so 
I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As such…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please lend me some money!! I have 
forgotten my wallet!!

Sakura Bakushin O bought me some sakura 
mochi, which was, indeed, delicious, with 
a little hint of sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, this place takes the first place 
cake for sakura mochi!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's almost as perfect as my mom's 
homemade ones. It's superb!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! She is an excellent mother to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've actually been thinking about 
something. I haven't told anyone about it 
yet, but…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sakura mochi is one of the best rice cakes 
in the world, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Could it be, perhaps they're…… named after 
me!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In honor of me, a top class person, it was 
dubbed "Sakura" mochi, don't you think…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
When you think about it, somehow it makes 
it taste even better!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Surely, that's how my mother felt when she 
made it for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And surely, even now she's still waiting, 
kneading rice cakes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I hope that I can be a shining example to 
you all…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm already a pretty amazing, 
exemplary role model!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But, it was Trainer who helped me grow 
even more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, there were times when I 
doubted Trainer on the way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Does my Trainer want me to stay on the 
short track forever, just like everyone 
else? I wondered.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Despite that, I decided to trust Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And it's because of that that I've been 
able to run this far.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I ran the whole 3600 meters! I 
think I set quite the good example!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Please, let me ask you one thing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you believe in me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Spring and Autumn Tennoushou, Arima Kinen, 
and so on…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You believe I can win all those other 
races… don't you?

I could answer that question without any 
hesitation.

If she can keep up her speed and get off 
to a fast start, no one else will be able 
to catch up…

I'm sure she'll be able to win any race 
thrown at her… Someday!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I only wanted to hear you say it 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then, thank you for your continued support 
of me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim for complete domination of the 
Bakushin Road! Onwaaaards―!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
We're going to Bakushin together, you and 
me, until we win our dream!
